title: 9 Days After Flood, 2 Men Are Pulled Alive From Mud-Filled Tunnels in Nepal
summary_full: One of two workers rescued from a hydroelectric plant said he had recited prayers over and over while trapped deep underground. “How many days has it been?” he asked.
